items.claim: CFO 稱對 2026 年的能見度與過去持平或更好，過去在軟體端一向能見度較強
items.quote: as good, if not better than what we've had before.
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱過去 3-5 年平均營收成長約 14%，其中約 2% 來自併購、12% 為有機成長
items.quote: we've probably been averaging around 14% revenue growth
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱公司通常以兩位數成長編列預算，實際結果常落在低雙位數(low teens)
items.quote: we budget for double-digit revenue growth
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱有機業務目標為 50% 以上增量利潤率，實際約達 60%
items.quote: We're probably hitting 60% organically.
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱 2024 年未達成 50% 增量利潤率目標，原因是 BETA 併購太晚導致時間不足
items.quote: in 2024, we missed that 50% incremental margin target
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱若合併看 2024-2025 兩年，增量利潤率約落在公司長期平均的 53%-54%
items.quote: you're probably getting incremental margin of about 53%, which is kind of 53%, 54%
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱 MSC（自 Hexagon 拆分之 Design and Engineering 業務）獨立年收入約 2.8 億美元
items.quote: I think they were doing about $280 million of revenue stand-alone
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱若將 MSC 多年合約全部轉為年約，年化營收約 2 億美元
items.quote: probably a run rate of about $200 million a year
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱 MSC 併購後需 12-15 個月萃取綜效
items.quote: it will take us 12 to 15 months to extract those
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱 MSC 是公司歷來最大的一筆併購案，未來 1-2 年 M&A 重心將放在整合 MSC，其餘僅為小型 tuck-in
items.quote: MSC is the biggest thing we've probably ever done
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱硬體模擬更新周期仍處早期階段，因設計複雜度大增使硬體模擬更關鍵
items.quote: it still feels like early innings because everything has become so much more complex
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱硬體需求強勁，客戶即使拿不到 Z3 也會要求 Z2 系統
items.quote: Customers are asking for our Z2s if we can't get them to Z3.
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱硬體交期目標落在 8 到 22 週之間，目前落在中段位置
items.quote: We tried to aim for somewhere between 8 and 22 weeks of lead time.
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱與台積電關係一向很強，近期在三星、英特爾的合作明顯增加
items.quote: we're very, very strong at TSMC, but we've been increasingly engaged in places like Samsung and Intel
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱非 AI 半導體客戶今年出現較大型合作案，似已觸底
items.quote: this year, we're seeing bigger engagements and I think they've probably found their base now at this point
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱對中國客戶需求韌性感到意外，限制鬆綁後客戶急欲拿到硬體積壓訂單
items.quote: we're surprised with the resilience of China customers
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱中國缺乏先進製程帶來的 AI 拉動效應，預期未來 3-5 年成長率略低於公司平均
items.quote: we don't see the same AI pull-through there as we're seeing in other regions
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱優先出貨中國硬體積壓訂單，使 Q3、Q4 末硬體積壓中中國占比將明顯低於平常
items.quote: there'll be much less of a percentage of China in it than there normally is
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱觀察到競爭對手 Synopsys 近年在 IP 業務上作風變得更偏交易型
items.quote: Synopsys maybe over the last few years have become more transactional
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱客戶不想被 Synopsys 或 ARM 綁死，希望有更多 IP 選擇，預期公司在 IP 市場競爭將隨業務下推而增加
items.quote: there'll probably be more competition from us
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱公司在 IP 業務上採長期夥伴模式，自稱是「農夫不是獵人」
items.quote: We're farmers, not hunters.
items.speaker: John Wall

items.claim: CFO 稱回測過去十年，僅一年 Q4 訂單量未超過 Q4 營收，本季度延續強勁開局，預期將以創紀錄的積壓訂單收尾今年
items.quote: there's only 1 year where Q4 bookings didn't exceed Q4 revenue
items.speaker: John Wall

qa_flags.question: AI 對 EDA 業務的貢獻能否量化，是否比之前更接近能給出數字的階段？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給出量化數字，改以「很難拆分」帶過，轉談 AI 工具帶動的授權使用量與遞延／分期認列營收的質性描述，未正面回答是否更接近量化。

qa_flags.question: 非 AI 半導體客戶的 EDA 支出是否會在明年加速？
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 以「很難說」開頭迴避直接判斷，隨即轉向設計複雜度上升、工具日益不可或缺的一般性說法，未針對「是否加速」給出明確答案。
